Name: Music Deck Bridge
Description: Control YouTube Music directly in Chrome.

io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.now.Name: Now Playing
io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.now.Tooltip: Show artwork, song and artist. Press to play/pause or open YouTube Music when closed.

io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.tog.Name: Play / Pause
io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.tog.Tooltip: Play/pause, or open YouTube Music when no player is open.

io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.vol.Name: Volume Dial
io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.vol.Tooltip: Turn to adjust volume; push or touch to mute.

io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.tra.Name: Current Track Dial
io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.tra.Tooltip: Turn for previous/next track; push or touch to play/pause. Show song info or album artwork.

io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.ope.Name: Open YouTube Music
io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.ope.Tooltip: Open or focus YouTube Music in Chrome.

io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.lik.Name: Like
io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.lik.Tooltip: Like the current song; press again to remove the like.

io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.dis.Name: Dislike
io.github.minjungw00.musicdeckbridge.dis.Tooltip: Dislike the current song; press again to remove the dislike.
